en.label: English
en.subject: Application for Full Stack Web Developer Position
en.message:
Hello,

I am reaching out to apply for an opportunity as a Full Stack Web Developer within your company.

I hold a diploma in Digital Development — Full Stack Web specialization from the Cité des Métiers et des Compétences (CMC), and I have over 2 years of experience in web development.

I specialize in React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and NestJS, and I design and develop secure, high-performance, and scalable web applications, with particular attention to code quality and user experience.

My CV is attached to this email. You can also visit my portfolio, which showcases my projects and professional background:
https://abdellah-edaoudi.vercel.app/en

I would be pleased to get in touch with you if an opportunity matching my profile becomes available.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Kind regards,
Abdellah Edaoudi
